headline: JSA acts on India leg of SAP Inc's acquisition of Reltio
sum: JSA Advocates & Solicitors represented and assisted Reltio, Inc. on Indian law aspects of its acquisition by SAP, Inc.
detail: JSA Advocates & Solicitors represented and assisted Reltio, Inc. on Indian law aspects of its acquisition by SAP, Inc. The Firm advised on all Indian legal and regulatory aspects of the transaction, including structuring and review of transaction documents from an Indian law perspective and assistance in preparation of disclosures. The transaction team was led by Vivek K.
